answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 29253 Country: India Title: I am educated unemployed since seven yrs, do not have source of income ,totally dependent on my in-laws. I do not have any bank balance,only owned house . I have declared my wife of complete owner of all ornaments which were given in marraige.i need some money to perform some ruhani ilaj. Can i take & use interest money of in-laws or anybody for this purpose. Question: ASSALA ALAIKUM, I AM EDUCATED UNEMPLOYED SINCE SEVEN YRS, DO NOT HAVE SOURCE OF INCOME ,TOTALLY DEPENDENT ON MY IN-LAWS. I DO NOT HAVE ANY BANK BALANCE,ONLY OWNED HOUSE . I HAVE DECLARED MY WIFE OF COMPLETE OWNER OF ALL ORNAMENTS WHICH WERE GIVEN IN MARRAIGE.I NEED SOME MONEY TO PERFORM SOME RUHANI ILAJ. CAN I TAKE & USE INTEREST MONEY OF IN-LAWS OR ANYBODY FOR THIS PURPOSE. Answer ID: 29253 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 246/177/H=1432) For ruhani treatment, neither it is lawful to ask your in-laws nor take interest based loan, rather it is haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
